messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 — Pacifica VPC canary error spike detected. Error rate 5x baseline on tenant pacifica-vpc-canary. Alert group: infra-api, eng-runtime, eng-sre.
Anika: on it, taking initial triage. Paging Sam (runtime oncall) and Leo (sre).
Sam: I can join in 2 mins, pulling logs. What’s the scope?
Oncall Bot: Root checks: elevated 5xx from runtime service on canary shard pool r-pac-01. Autoscaler kicked but can't drain.
Leo: quick check — is this only canary subset or affecting reserved pool?
Pacifica SRE: Confirmed: only canary traffic (we routed 10% to canary). Production reserved/dedicated pools unaffected so far. Customer is watching.
Anika: good. Need to decide pinback vs rollback. Any recent pinned artifact rollouts?
Sam: Deploys last 15m: progressive canary of model-serving artifact `inference-engine:v3.10-canary` and runtime lib `kv-cache:1.4.0`. Metrics show tail latency and 502s from kv-cache.
Ops Lead: customer-facing note: Pacifica SRE — we'll isolate canary and revert that artifact. Will ack you before we touch traffic.
Pacifica SRE: Please do. We're seeing degraded responses in our user-facing flow. Keep us posted.
Anika: plan: (1) Pause canary routing; (2) Pin canary tenant to previous artifact `inference-engine:v3.9.8`; (3) Monitor error rate for 15m; (4) If errors persist, fail open to reserved pool and notify customer.
Leo: I’ll prepare the pin command and a quick isolation:
```
# pause canary routing
rctl routing update --customer pacifica --pool canary --weight 0
# pin artifact back to stable
rctl artifacts pin --customer pacifica --pool canary --artifact inference-engine:v3.9.8
```
Sam: Also add kv-cache fallback to software path: `kvcache->local` to reduce 502s while we roll back.
Anika: @Deploy Bot can you execute the pause and pin?
Deploy Bot: Starting run: pause routing -> pin artifact. Executing playbook `incidents/tenant-pinback-v1`.
Deploy Bot: Step 1/3 pause routing completed: `r-pac-01` now at 0% canary traffic.
Deploy Bot: Step 2/3 pin artifact completed: pacifica canary pinned to `inference-engine:v3.9.8`.
Sam: confirming logs — kv-cache 502s dropped to near zero within 30s of pin. Latency back to baseline for canary VPC.
Anika: Monitoring dashboard: error rate now falling from 5x -> 1.1x. Ops Lead: prepare customer-facing blurb.
Ops Lead: Drafting: "We've identified a bad canary artifact causing intermittent 502s for your canary traffic. We pinned your canary back to the previous stable artifact and paused canary traffic. No impact to main reserved pool. We'll monitor and re-run canary once stable"
Pacifica SRE: Thanks. Can you share any root cause pointers we should pass to our internal teams?
Sam: Preliminary: regression in kv-cache interaction with last runtime lib change; likely an edge-case cache miss causing 502s under certain sequence lengths. We’ll run an eval.
Leo: I'll capture heap/conn metrics and trace example request flow.
Anika: Hand-off — I’m going offline in 20m. Sam/Leo you own monitoring and deciding to unpause. I’ll update slack and incident ticket.
Oncall Bot: Handoff: Anika -> Sam at 1969007880. Pager silence set for Anika.
Sam: Acknowledged, taking lead. Will keep 5m check-ins.
Deploy Bot: Step 3/3: post-action smoke tests passed. Canary pool health: OK.
Leo: Running 15m post-mitigation retention checks. Attaching quick grep of errors:
```
2026-11-18T10:47:12Z r-pac-01 kvcache GET 502 seq_len=4096 key=usr-9382
2026-11-18T10:47:13Z r-pac-01 kvcache GET 502 seq_len=8192 key=usr-4421
```
Anika: good capture. Sam, if 15m clear, we either re-run canary with additional logging or mark mitigated and close postmortem.
Pacifica SRE: Please keep us posted on the postmortem — we'll need the timeline for our audit.
Sam: 10m into post-check: error rate stable at baseline; no customer-visible failures noted beyond canary.
Leo: I'm grabbing flamegraphs and will upload to the incident ticket.
Anika: Updating incident ticket: mitigation applied (pinned artifact), pause routing, customer notified, handoff Sam.
Ops Lead: We should consider an automated safety: block canary rollout if kv-cache version bump present without compatibility flag. Filing an action item.
Sam: Agreed. Filed ACTION-2371: add canary-safety gate for kv-cache/runtime compatibility.
Pacifica SRE: Thanks team — appreciate the quick coordination. We'll keep our folks on standby.
Oncall Bot: Incident severity reduced to P2. Monitoring until 1969008477.
Sam: I'll keep monitoring and will ping if any regression. If stable through the window, I'll mark mitigated and start a short RCA outline.
Anika: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: Audit log: 1969007777 - paused routing; 1969007782 - pinned artifact inference-engine:v3.9.8; executed by playbook incidents/tenant-pinback-v1.
Leo: Uploaded logs and traces to the incident ticket.
Sam: Marking mitigated at 1969008042 pending postmortem.
Oncall Bot: Thread closed for now; reopen if new alerts."
